input_constraints: Library presets contain selectors, not retail node payloads. Extract from the currently loaded book; source body SHA-256 and exact position/ordinal codes bind the bundle.

Copy complete declared chains, including alternate terminal paths. Preserve explicit flags. Friendly exchange/transfer/synchronization dependencies cannot be split; opponent selectors are not friendly slots.
Partial copies need matching families, run/pass/play-action headers and defensive component. Unlinked plays and special teams are inspectable; the wizard refuses their application.
No new double-team, automatic slide, modern match, spy or zone-read AI policy is authored. Combo Inside Zone is defense; Inside Zone Read and Slide protection have no exact-name retail donors.

Reuse identical donor pointers; changed chains use the existing fixed-capacity writer with full validator, menu and synchronization checks. Same-resource byte identity applies only without other edits.
Project/pack exports may contain copied operands and explicit flags. Keep extracted exports local; they are not Studio release assets. No cross-book automatic bundle application.
portme: Noah must capture copied coverage exchanges, blocking/slide behavior, screens and both native option paths in gameplay before any runtime-proved classification.
